versions.title: Explain Cards & Back Button
changes: New 💡 explain button on each card — tap to get an AI explanation of that specific card with examples and memory tips
Android back button now navigates through the app — back from study mode returns to the set, back from a set returns home, back on home asks if you want to exit
Removed generic Explain a card from AI assistant menu — per-card explanations are now more useful

versions.title: Version 1 — Full Feature Release
changes: Flashcard, Learn, Quiz and Match study modes
Progress tracking, import, backup and restore
Offline support via service worker — no ads, no account required
Study streak counter and text-to-speech with automatic French voice detection
Dictation — speak your term or definition instead of typing
AI Revision Assistant powered by Claude — generate questions, focus on weak cards, find gaps, quiz mode, and per-card explanations
Subjects with exam board support (AQA, Edexcel, OCR, WJEC, CIE, SQA, CCEA) — sets grouped and collapsible on home screen
School year per set — AI tailors language and difficulty accordingly
Automatic and manual update settings with changelog popup
